scope: Static Toolkit 1.18 KEYE class/group/Area analysis, bounded Python cached/native projection, and a read-only sweep of an unchanged VM project snapshot. The original executable was not executed; no database, CNI or physical device was mutated or accessed during the sweep.

static_facts.factory: The KEYE initializer registers KEYE1 through KEYE4 and KEYEIR1 through KEYEIR4 to TKEYEx with firmware bounds 0 and 9.
static_facts.selected_profiles: This increment admits only the independently observed KEYE1, KEYE2 and KEYE3 firmware 2.5.00 subset.
static_facts.interaction_slots: The TKEYEx VMT resolves IsInteractionGroup to TCBusNeoInputUnit.IsInteractionGroup, which returns true for ordinal indices 0 through 7.
static_facts.area: The TKEYEx VMT resolves Area to TCBusInputUnit.GetAreaIfAvailable, which loads AreaGroupAddress and resolves the address in the primary application's group manager on each call.
static_facts.group_associations: GetBlockGroup resolves each stored block address through GroupByAddress and LoadGroups appends each non-nil block group in block order. Repeated address255 associations therefore remain repeated ordered slots.
static_facts.legacy_identity: Native project OIDs are optional. Canonical selected paths provide detached in-memory identity when an OID element is absent; the retained OID value remains empty.

read_only_snapshot_sweep.source: unchanged GRENACHE.xml copied read-only from the user-owned Windows VM

focused_acceptance.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:. .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_selection tests.test_toolkit_database_csv tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_projection tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_native tests.test_toolkit_database_csv_area tests.test_cli_toolkit_database_csv

remaining_limits: Other unit families and firmware profiles
